mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SPECIAL.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, SPECIAL.IS_ABS isAbs, SPECIAL.IS_SPECIAL_DEBT isSpecialDebt, SPECIAL.IS_DEFAULT_BOND_INDICATOR isDefaultBondIndicator, SPECIAL.INPUT_TYPE inputType, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr FROM FIN_PRODUCT_SPECIAL SPECIAL INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT ON SPECIAL.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID UNION SELECT SPECIAL.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, SPECIAL.IS_ABS isAbs, SPECIAL.IS_SPECIAL_DEBT isSpecialDebt, SPECIAL.IS_DEFAULT_BOND_INDICATOR isDefaultBondIndicator, SPECIAL.INPUT_TYPE inputType, INTERF.SECNAME finprodAbbr FROM FIN_PRODUCT_SPECIAL SPECIAL INNER JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO INTERF ON SPECIAL.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = INTERF.SECID WHERE INTERF.SECID NOT IN (SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND TRADE_MARKET = '01') ) where FINPRODMARKETID = #{finprodMarketId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, P.FINPROD_ABBR text, type.type_10 type FROM FIN_PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE type on p.FINPROD_ID = type.FINPROD_ID WHERE P.FINPROD_MARKET_ID NOT IN ( SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT_SPECIAL WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID is NOT NULL) AND P.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND P.TRADE_MARKET = '01' UNION SELECT SECID id, SECNAME text, null type FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO PAYHSRCSECINFO WHERE PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID NOT IN ( SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND TRADE_MARKET = '01' ) AND PAYHSRCSECINFO.MARKET = '01' AND PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID NOT IN ( SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT_SPECIAL WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID is NOT NULL) )
AND ( id LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR text LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )

SELECT COUNT(1) qst FROM ( SELECT P.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, P.FINPROD_ABBR text, type.type_10 type FROM FIN_PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE type on p.FINPROD_ID = type.FINPROD_ID WHERE P.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND P.TRADE_MARKET = '01' AND ( P.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{search} or P.FINPROD_ABBR = #{search} ) UNION SELECT SECID id, SECNAME text, null type FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO PAYHSRCSECINFO WHERE PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID NOT IN ( SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND TRADE_MARKET = '01' ) AND PAYHSRCSECINFO.MARKET = '01' AND (PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = #{search} or PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECNAME = #{search} ) )
SELECT COUNT(1) num FROM FIN_PRODUCT_SPECIAL where FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
